Monetary policy assessment

Assessments as of 19 June 2026

The Swiss National Bank (SNB) is lowering the SNB policy rate by 25 basis points to 1.25%.

Inflation has increased slightly in recent months, mainly because of higher rents and the strength of the Swiss franc. Over the medium term, inflation is still clearly within the range consistent with price stability.

The SNB will continue to monitor price developments closely. The SNB stands ready to adjust policy if necessary.
